name: Powering the Pylons
summary: Mordent Evenshade asks you to restore the damaged pylons in Shen'dralas. Floating mana has appeared there, and he needs it gathered and returned to the pylons.

sections.title: Gathering Mana
sections.body: Inside Shen'dralas's temple, you seek the Mana Sieve, an artifact its denizens may resent you borrowing. Mordent Evenshade needs the scattered mana gathered in a semicrystallized form. With enough Ancient Mana Crystals, you can empower the damaged pylons and bring the sieve's work back to him.

sections.title: The Pylons
sections.body: Mordent Evenshade sees the pylons restored and gestures toward the sky. He notices your subdued response as he turns back to you.

faq.answer: Mordent needs mana gathered as Ancient Mana Crystals to empower the damaged pylons in Shen'dralas.

faq.q: Where do I find the Mana Sieve?
faq.answer: The Mana Sieve is inside the temple in Shen'dralas.

faq.q: What is happening to the mana in Shen'dralas?
faq.answer: Floating sparks of mana have appeared around Shen'dralas, likely because the pylons have suffered damage.

faq.q: What does the Mana Sieve do?
faq.answer: You use the Mana Sieve to gather floating mana as Ancient Mana Crystals.

faq.q: Who is asking for the pylons to be empowered?
faq.answer: Mordent Evenshade asks you to gather mana and empower the pylons.

attribution: In-game quest text: Powering the Pylons
